title: Hover on a narrowed `readonly` property read shows the declared type, not the narrowed one.
text: Hover reads `ExprInfo::Property`'s `ty`, and the narrowed type is in its `narrowed` field (`rule:types/narrowing`). Inside `if ($x->p != null) { … }` hover on `$x->p` still shows `null|T`, although the checker treats the read as `T`.
